changelog_text:
### Added

- KSA's own UI kit for Rust and Rhai, so mod windows look like the game's: `KSA.ConsoleStyle` windows (title bar with a signature tag, body, footer and status) and `KSA.ConsoleWidgets` controls (normal, primary, positive and danger buttons, region headers, rules, readouts, labelled rows, checkboxes, sliders, drags, combos, text lines, color swatches, segmented buttons, tooltips). Rust: `oxidizer_api::ksa_ui` (API version 8). Rhai: `ksa_begin_window`, `ksa_end_window`, `ksa_begin_body`, `ksa_end_body`, `ksa_begin_footer`, `ksa_end_footer`, `ksa_footer_status`, `ksa_push_widget_style`, `ksa_pop_widget_style`, `ksa_button`, `ksa_primary_button`, `ksa_positive_button`, `ksa_danger_button`, `ksa_region_header`, `ksa_rule`, `ksa_readout`, `ksa_value_text`, `ksa_begin_row`, `ksa_end_row`, `ksa_checkbox`, `ksa_slider_float`, `ksa_slider_int`, `ksa_drag_float`, `ksa_drag_int`, `ksa_combo`, `ksa_text_line`, `ksa_color_edit`, `ksa_segmented`, `ksa_item_tooltip`.
- More ImGui widgets for Rust and Rhai: tree nodes (`tree_node`, `tree_pop`), tables (`begin_table`, `table_setup_column`, `table_headers_row`, `table_next_row`, `table_next_column`, `end_table`), popups (`open_popup`, `begin_popup`, `begin_popup_modal`, `end_popup`, `close_current_popup`), tooltips (`item_tooltip(text)`, `is_item_hovered`; Rust also `begin_tooltip`/`end_tooltip`), plots (`plot_lines`, `plot_histogram`), `radio_button`, `selectable`, `list_box`, `slider_int`, `drag_float`, `drag_int`, `text_wrapped`, `spacing`, and `begin_ex(title, flags)` / `begin_child_ex(id, w, h, border)` for window flags and sized child regions (`oxidizer_api` 0.9.0, with `imgui::window_flags` and `imgui::table_flags`).

### Changed

- The bridge is compiled against the game's assemblies (`KsaDir`: the game folder locally; the private `SafeShows/ksa-game-assemblies` in CI, read with the `KSA_ASSEMBLIES_KEY` deploy key). Nothing from the game is shipped.

listing.name: Oxidizer
listing.abstract: Mod loader that runs Kitten Space Agency mods written in Rust or as Rhai scripts.
listing.description:
Oxidizer is a mod loader for Kitten Space Agency, written in Rust. It loads code mods written in Rust and mods written as Rhai scripts, so no C# is needed.

![The two example mods, one in Rhai and one in Rust, drawing ImGui windows in game](ksa-image:example-mods)

This is the standalone loader: you start the game through `oxidizer.exe` (`oxidizer` on Linux) instead of the game, and no StarMap is needed. If you use StarMap or other C# mods, install `Oxidizer.StarMap` instead: the same Oxidizer as a StarMap mod, and the same mods run with both.

Mods can run code every frame, draw their own ImGui windows with the game's ImGui, read and change game objects, patch game methods before or after they run and change what they return, react to hotkeys, keep their own settings, and add entries to a Mods menu in the game's menu bar. **Mods > Oxidizer** shows the loaded mods, their errors and the log.

Rhai mods are plain `.rhai` files that need no compiling, and they reload while the game runs when you save them. Rust mods use the `oxidizer_api` crate from crates.io, and `oxidizer --bindgen` generates typed Rust bindings for the whole game, with autocomplete and compile-time checks.

Mods go in `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/<ModName>/`. Oxidizer loads a mod when its `mod.toml` has an `[oxidizer]` section that names a `dll` or a `script`, and skips mods that are disabled in the game's manifest. The first run writes an `oxidizer.toml` next to the executable, where `game_path` points at the folder Kitten Space Agency was installed in.

Oxidizer runs on Windows and Linux.
